result.summary: Found 1 major accessibility issue: the promotional banner copy is too low-contrast against its pale green background.

issues.description: In the promotional banner, the white/very light heading and details—especially “Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10”—blend into the pale green background and are difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use dark green or near-black banner text, or darken the banner background, so all text meets contrast guidelines while keeping the button visually distinct.
